title: System and process boundaries
scope: CLI/daemon process; Electron main/preload/renderer; agent subprocesses; local store; external services

claims.statement: CLI bootstrap composes registries, file or memory stores, PlanService, Orchestrator and ProgramService; most CLI commands execute this stack in their own process.
The daemon exposes HTTP RPC and an optional WebSocket endpoint using injected models and event sources. It is a mode of the CLI executable, not a separate orchestration implementation.
Electron main owns a daemon client, daemon lifecycle and IPC. The renderer receives a named bridge through an isolated sandboxed preload.
Agent execution crosses a local-child or SSH stdio boundary; artifact collection reads the agent host filesystem and records content in the orchestrator store.
JEV optionally sends selected artifact bodies and rendered context to an external HTTPS service; this is separate from ACP agent execution.
Trust rests on configured programs, plugins, filesystem ownership and daemon reachability. The shown RPC dispatcher performs message/schema validation but has no caller identity authorization.
